decisions.reason: After only two years of standalone promotion and no later visibility, this resin injection unit likely fell short of aspiration levels, so management would reallocate engineering and sales effort to stronger core lines or new development.

With the same brief market visibility as A and no sign of continued support through 2021, this overlapping resin injection unit would be judged below aspiration and dropped to free resources for better-performing uses.

Because the automatic airless spray gun was shown only in the launch period and not thereafter, a boundedly rational management would treat it as an underperforming extension and discontinue it rather than carry continuing uncertainty.

The manual airless spray gun appears to have lost market prominence after 2019, suggesting results below aspiration, and the firm would likely shift resources back to established spray equipment with more reliable demand.

Although close to the firm’s core technology, the air-assisted airless spray gun does not show sustained market presence beyond the initial period, so management would likely end it when slack is not enough to justify prolonged weak performance.
The data logger was already downgraded from its own page to a mere mention by 2019, which is a clear signal of results below aspiration and makes it the strongest candidate for discontinuation.
